author: Parsifal-2045
body:
#### PR description:

Title says it all. Testing on 2 Milan CPUs (256 threads total) + 2 NVIDIA L4 gives about a 50/50 ratio between CPU and GPU compute. The chosen setup of jobs, threads and streams mimics what was used in production for Run 3.
This also solves a long-standing issue of the previous configuration where `--slot` did not specify which GPU to use, resulting in all jobs having access to both GPUs, causing worse resource sharing and performance. Now jobs will be correctly assigned to either GPU and be pinned there.
This is the result of some checks prompted by #52111 with the idea of testing the two independently and then verify their combined effect. 

#### PR validation:

Purely technical change, to be tested by the bot
title: Restore full CPU utilisation in the Phase-2 HLT timing test
